uniqueAdvisories.applicability: Aborted traversal can continue reading directories. npm commands resolve this module through map-workspaces/package-json/cacache. Selected root has no workspaces; reviewed npm callers do not pass an AbortSignal. Absence of an observed abort is not a general nonreachability proof.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Insufficient proof for a blanket vulnerability pass; affected on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Major-version upgrade: review API/runtime compatibility and npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: npm network helpers resolve socks-proxy-agent -> socks -> ip-address. Observed socks Address6 calls use fromByteArray over an exactly 16-byte SOCKS reply, and outbound IPv6 is screened by net.isIPv6; that path does not feed an unbounded zone string into Address6. Generic Address6 APIs remain vulnerable.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: No vulnerable string path found in inspected SOCKS calls; affected on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: glob forces optimizationLevel=2, the affected preprocessing mode. Other npm callers and TUF/ignore filtering also use minimatch. Exact root has no workspaces and no hostile pattern was observed, but package/workspace/glob inputs require stronger trust proof. Module-load tracing cannot establish that proof.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Potential executable path remains unresolved; fail closed.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Major-version upgrade: review API/runtime compatibility and npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: Bundled undici is imported by node-gyp/download.js, which uses Agent/EnvHttpProxyAgent/RetryAgent/fetch. It does not use EventSource. Actual configured GitHub plugin resolves to external undici7.30.1. No EventSource constructor occurs in inspected selected command paths.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Feature not observed in selected paths; affected on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: node-gyp fetch is a real network sink. Both npm ci invocations and npx in the official workflow use --ignore-scripts; installed-signature tracing records no bundled undici resolution. Explicit node-gyp/native-build use would expose the vulnerable fetch path. GitHub fetch uses fixed7.30.1.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: No execution of bundled fetch shown for retained workflow; callable vulnerable sink remains on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: Requires a function-valued custom tls verifier dropped by Agent cloning. node-gyp supplies custom CA through connect/requestTls/proxyTls, not tls callbacks. GitHub plugin uses fixed7.30.1. No matching custom-tls use found in selected command paths.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Trigger not found in inspected calls; affected on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: The node-gyp Agent/fetch path can use TLS1.2; no version restriction is present. Scripts are ignored in the retained workflow, but a later explicit node-gyp download could reach this sink. GitHub external undici7.30.1 and hosted Node24.22.1 builtin7.30.1 are fixed.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Not observed during retained commands; callable vulnerable sink remains on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

uniqueAdvisories.applicability: Requires WebSocket PING/PONG handling. node-gyp imports fetch and agents, not WebSocket. No WebSocket construction occurs in selected npm/release paths. Fixed external GitHub undici is a separate resolution.
uniqueAdvisories.disposition: Feature not observed in selected paths; affected on disk.
uniqueAdvisories.compatibilityRequirement: Same-major target; verify npm bundled-dependency integration, regenerate lock and test a clean script-disabled install.

A verified fixed npm distribution or reviewed upstream/vendor integration plus regenerated lock and actual clean installation is still required. No future producer revision or version is assigned. Separately remediate/content-verify the hosted npm frontend; a clean project audit does not audit that global frontend or Node builtin modules.
